description: tangent-outside-cut's tool moved into the plate by a tolerance (1e-7), or turned about the contact's middle so its ends move a quarter or a half of one in and out. Arris fails: a piece with no interior point at its clearance (Fault::Split, NoInterior; the offset), a fit of the section of the face's plane and the tool's wall that still deviates past the tolerance at its most spans (Fault::Geometry; the quarter turn), a section edge ending at a node nothing else reaches (Fault::Split, Dangling; the half). The desired result is a clean cut: the plate within the tolerance, the plate less a sliver beyond. Open CASCADE imprints the contact on the face (10/14/6/6, and 10/15/7/7 at the half turn) where Arris keeps a face whole that a touch removes no material from (tangent-outside-cut's counts_differ); the step that fixes this states Arris's counts per variant (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
